The Delphi API lets you integrate your Digital Mind (an AI clone trained on your content) directly into your own app, platform, or workflow. Create conversations, stream text and voice responses, manage your audience and its contextual memory, organize contacts with tags, search your clone's knowledge base for RAG, and track per-user usage. API access is available on the Immortal plan. All endpoints authenticate with an API key passed in the x-api-key header and are scoped to a single clone.
